notes: ADR-0263 (2026-10-12): ThetaData Options Standard daily chains, tier 1b (index options). Cash-settled index option roots: SPX, SPXW, NDX, NDXP, RUT, RUTW, VIX, VIXW, XSP, DJX, OEX, XEO. Store: /home/russell/data/thetadata/options-index. Window 2016-01-04 to 2025-12-31 (end is exclusive 2026-01-01): Standard history starts 2016-01 and no 2026 row is acquired. One greeks/eod + open_interest request per (root, trade date), merged on contract, newest date first, roots in the order listed; 4 concurrent requests (the plan limit). Gzip raw and observations (about 117 B/row each; uncompressed would be 2 KB/row). Needs the local Theta Terminal running on 127.0.0.1:25503 (java -jar ThetaTerminalv3.jar --creds-file ~/.config/dskit/thetadata-creds.txt). Run: init --root ROOT; register-source theta --catalog-source theta --connector dskit.onboarding.libs.thetadata:ThetaDataConnector --config @configs/<this file> --activate --root ROOT; then acquire --source theta --stream option_eod --mode backfill --root ROOT, repeated until a pull emits no records.
